arcade.name: Arcade
arcade.notes: Renamed Growth to Pro and replaced per-seat pricing with credit tiers; entry price went from $59 to $49.

coupa.name: Coupa
coupa.notes: Advanced plan’s AI invoice automation capped at 2,000 uploads, down from unlimited. The supplier pricing page returned 403 in an earlier run, so no URL is confirmed.

akiflow.name: Akiflow
akiflow.notes: Removed the Believer 2-year ($14.90/mo) and 5-year ($699) commitment options, leaving only standard Pro pricing.

automox.name: Automox
automox.notes: Automate Essentials’ third-party patch titles cut from 730+ to 633+, two weeks after being raised from 630+; Patch OS lists at $1 per endpoint a month.

intuit-proconnect.name: Intuit ProConnect
intuit-proconnect.notes: Per-return prices now show about 15% off struck-through list prices (Individual $109.95 → $93.46; Business $129.95 → $110.46). proconnect.intuit.com/pricing now redirects to a general Intuit accountan

apploye.name: Apploye
apploye.notes: Free Starter plan’s tracked apps and URLs cut from 10 to 8 per person a day, leave-document upload removed and expense tracking limited; a 40%-off Power promo runs until 19 Nov.

socket.name: Socket
socket.notes: Free plan now covers 1 dev seat; the page read “Unlimited developers & repos” on 10 Oct.

hivemq.name: HiveMQ
hivemq.notes: Stopped new Serverless clusters and retires the Serverless plan (Free and Pay As You Go) on 2026-12-31.

fly-io.name: Fly.io
fly-io.notes: Raised Machines memory to $6.00 per GB a month from about $5 in October, lifting small-machine prices.

groq.name: Groq
groq.notes: Cut free-tier limits on gpt-oss-safeguard-20b from 30 to 3 requests a minute without an announcement (October).

browser-use.name: Browser Use
browser-use.notes: One-time sign-up credit cut from $15 to $1 (by 4 Oct).

mockoon.name: Mockoon
mockoon.notes: Replaced hosted Mockoon Cloud plans with self-hosted Mockoon Pro at €10 per license a month; the old Team plan was $100 a month, billed annually, for 5 members.
